description: The default IEmailPreviewRenderer: renders locally through IEmailTemplateRenderer and projects the result onto the preview contract. Warnings keep the status Rendered (the HTML is complete), a real render error is RenderFailed with empty html/text/subject, an unexpected failure of the renderer itself is Unavailable so the editor offers a retry, and OperationCanceledException is never swallowed. SubstituteVariables = false renders the same pipeline without substituting, keeping the {{ }} tokens for an HTML export.
